data.text: Hello Eleanor, this is Mira Mace with news about your wheelchair. ChicagoLand Durable Medical will be the supplier, and they will call you from (312) 555-0301. Medicare rules mean we need your written permission before the supplier can call you. We will send you a short form to sign so they can get in touch.

Medicare Part B rents the wheelchair to you month by month, and you own it at the end of the rental period. Each year your Part B deductible is paid before Medicare starts paying, and after that you pay your share of each month's Medicare-approved amount. Your supplier accepts Medicare assignment, so it bills you only for your share, at or after delivery. In total we estimate your share at about $71.97 if your deductibles are already met by other bills, and up to about $353.20 if they are not. The estimate assumes the Part B deductible for 2027 stays at $283, because that has not been announced yet.
